name: Conscript
description:
You have performed the mandatory military service of the Underdark.

When you gain this ability, choose two:

  • Choose and gain three Underdark-made equipment items of martial grade without paying their Treasure cost.

  • Choose Strength or Dexterity. Whenever you roll the chosen skill, +1d.

  • Your base Defense increases by 2.

Whichever options you choose, you also gain 2 Shadow, and your Shadow can never be reduced to less than 2.

Describe your military experience.
